tools.name: search_interior_answers
tools.description: Search ABIS public interior planning answers for room layout, kitchen storage, bedroom styling, lighting, bathroom renovation cost factors and consultation preparation. Returns grounded summaries and citation URLs. Does not search customer accounts or photos.

tools.name: get_interior_answer
tools.description: Read an ABIS public interior answer by the slug returned from search_interior_answers. Returns practical guidance, a checklist and relevant public construction references when available. Cite the answer for planning guidance and the case URL for the specific work shown. tools.name: get_interior_styles

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_interior_answers, get_interior_answer, start_interior_design, search_construction_cases · Private data: start_interior_design, search_construction_cases, get_consultation_options · Public sink: get_consultation_options.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_interior_answers, get_interior_answer, start_interior_design, search_construction_cases · Private data: start_interior_design, search_construction_cases, get_consultation_options · Public sink: get_consultation_options

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
